Mistfall Hunter Review - Dark Fantasy Extraction ARPG
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be talking about my hands-on impressions with Mistfall Hunter, which is the latest PvP extraction game with a twist. The game is developed by Bellring Games, an independent studio based in Hong Kong, and Mistfall Hunter is set in a dark fantasy Nordic setting with action RPG gameplay bringing fresh take on the extraction genre.
